text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's bright and early on the day of the
Arima
Kinen, and Oguri Cap asks me to
meet for a chat.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Isn't this spot just so relaxing?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're in one of her favorite places—the
forest
behind the academy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Last night, I was thinking back on all
the
memories we've made till now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The day we met, all the training sessions
we've
had together...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her voice, though seemingly calm,
sounds rife
with various emotions...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
At first, I was just doing this for the sake
of
everyone back home. I wanted to live
up to their
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But then I met all the different people
I'd be
competing against, and I realized
that victory was
something I wanted for
myself too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I wanna win and make everyone happy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I wanna make all my fans glad that they
chose to
support me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's why I wanna win now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her fans' encouragement is what brought
Oguri
Cap this far. Today, at the
legendary Arima
Kinen, she's going to
show everyone what dreams
are made of.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I came here to win, so let's make a
promise.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm not going to let anyone else
beat me. I
want you to focus all your
hopes on me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks. I've got this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We can hear the crowd cheering. People
are
calling out to Tamamo Cross, Super
Creek, and
the other big names.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But that's not all.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oguri! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Oguriiin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They're also yelling for Oguri Cap, the
beast from
the boonies.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Call my name as loud as you can,
everyone! The
louder your voices, the
faster I'll run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begins the Arima Kinen, the race
to end
all races.
